lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a series of roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The anterior-most spots are smaller and more densely clustered, while the posterior spots increase in size and relative spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal arrangement of blobs, forming a grid-like pattern where larger spots are often centered within or bordering the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior surface and a shadow-induced lower intensity on the inferior surface.
